d:
The story begins with Kyouka arriving at a luxurious hotel, her heart pounding with nervous excitement. Dressed in formal business attire that contrasts with the nature of her appointment, she walks through illuminated streets knowing this night will change everything.

Inside, she meets her man—a connection forged through time and restrained desire. Over wine on a balcony overlooking the city, they confess their deepest fantasies: how he has imagined her lips wrapped around him, how she has touched herself dreaming of being torn apart in that very bed. The tension between them crackles with unspoken promises.
